description: This file defines a controller class 'Manufacturer' in the Opencart admin namespace. Its methods handle event-driven actions related to manufacturer entities, such as adding, editing, and deleting manufacturers, by scheduling background tasks for these operations and associated products.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Controller class managing manufacturer-related events, scheduling tasks for add, edit, and delete operations, including associated product updates.

methods.name: addManufacturer
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update manufacturer list and info after a new manufacturer is added.

methods.name: editManufacturer
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update manufacturer list, info, and related product info after a manufacturer is edited.

methods.name: deleteManufacturer
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update manufacturer list, delete manufacturer, and update related product info after a manufacturer is deleted.
